Definition: from G730 and G2845; a sodomite:--abuser of (that defile) self with mankind.
BiblicalUsage: This word names men who lie with men, and Paul puts it in two lists of sins. The unrighteous shall not inherit the kingdom of God, he says, naming fornicators, idolaters, adulterers and abusers of themselves with mankind; and the law, he tells Timothy, is made for the lawless and disobedient, for the ungodly and for sinners, among them abusers of themselves with mankind.
TheologicalSignificance: One hard word in two lists carries no doctrine of its own; its weight is the plain warning, that this sin is named among the sins that shut men out of the kingdom, and that the law names it because God names it.
